name: a later table row overwrites the first one's file list
edits: if m and m.group(1) not in out:
expect: the group table is read from the first row per letter, the Answered table's repeat ignored

name: wrong group sizes are accepted
expect: a decision table with the wrong group sizes is CANNOT RUN

name: excluded files are copied
expect: a clean build writes the kept files, the paraphrases and the index, and no excluded file

name: a D file ships its source, not its paraphrase
expect: a D file in the output is its paraphrase, not its source

name: the index keeps lines that link an excluded file
edits: if not any(f"({n})" in ln for n in excluded)]
expect: the index drops the lines that link an excluded file and keeps the rest

name: a stale paraphrase is used
expect: a stale paraphrase (its source changed after sources.json) is CANNOT RUN

name: a D file with no paraphrase is not refused
expect: a D file with no paraphrase is CANNOT RUN

name: a non-empty --out is not refused
edits: if out.exists() and (not out.is_dir() or any(out.iterdir())):
expect: a non-empty --out is CANNOT RUN

name: quotes are read over the whole file, not per paragraph
expect: a quote is read within one paragraph, never paired with a later paragraph's close

name: blockquote quotes are not extracted
expect: italic and multi-line blockquote quotes are both extracted

name: a quote is not split at an ellipsis
expect: an ellipsis splits a quote into fragments, and short fragments are dropped

name: a long fragment is searched for only whole
edits: return [" ".join(w[i:i + WINDOW]) for i in range(max(1, len(w) - WINDOW + 1))]
expect: a quote reused in part, with its other words changed, fails check 1 on a six-word run

name: markdown emphasis is not normalised away
expect: a source quote in a kept output file fails check 1, through emphasis, case and line breaks

name: a D file with no quote found is a pass
expect: ONE source D file with no quote is CANNOT RUN, though the other five have quotes

name: an empty output is a pass
expect: an output directory with no files is CANNOT RUN, not a pass

name: an excluded file in the output is not reported
expect: an excluded file in the output fails check 2

name: only the top level of the output is searched
edits: files = sorted(p for p in out.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
files = sorted(p for p in out.glob("*") if p.is_file())
expect: an excluded file nested in a subdirectory of the output fails check 2

name: a hit does not fail the check
expect: an excluded file in the output fails check 2

name: punctuation is not normalised away (characters compared, not words)
expect: a quote reproduced with its punctuation stripped, changed or added fails check 1 (words, not characters)

name: an excluded file's content under another name is not reported
expect: an excluded file's content in the output under another name fails check 2
